 Fernando Cervantes Jr. USA TODAY Updated Nov. 14, 2026, 11:07 p.m. ET Hear this story The winning numbers are in for the Saturday, Nov. 14 Powerball drawing , but it’s not yet clear whether anyone hit the $63 million jackpot with a cash value of $26.3 million.
 The jackpot was last hit Nov. 4, when a ticket sold in New Jersey won $847 million , the ninth-largest prize in Powerball history. The ticket was purchased at Wegmans in Montvale, but the winner has yet to publicly come forward.
 Here’s what to know about Saturday night’s drawing.
 Lottery luck: Which Powerball numbers should you pick? What are the Nov. 14 Powerball winning numbers?
 The winning numbers: 09-44-49-51-68 and the Powerball: 04 
 USA TODAY Shopping: Shop sales in tech, home, fashion, beauty & more curated by our editors. Power Play multiplier: 2x 
 When is the next Powerball drawing?
 The next Powerball drawing will take place Monday, Nov. 16, at around 10:59 p.m. ET. The drawing can be watched live on Powerball’s website, and players can rewatch clips on its YouTube channel.
 Powerball drawings are held Monday, Wednesday and Saturday.
 Biggest Powerball jackpots ever won
 $2.04 billion: Nov. 7, 2022, California
 $1.817 billion: Dec. 24, 2025, Arkansas
 $1.787 billion: Sept. 6, 2025, Missouri and Texas
 $1.765 billion: Oct. 11, 2023, California
 $1.586 billion: Jan. 13, 2016, California, Florida and Tennessee
 $1.326 billion: April 6, 2024, Oregon
 $1.08 billion: July 19, 2023, California
 $1.04 billion: Aug. 12, 2026, Illinois
 $847 million: Nov. 4, 2026, New Jersey
 $842.4 million: Jan. 1, 2024, Michigan
 How to play Powerball
 Powerball tickets cost $2 per play and are sold in 45 states, Washington, D.C., Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands. Depending on local laws, players may also be able to purchase tickets online.
 To play, select five white-ball numbers from 1 to 69 and one red Powerball number from 1 to 26. Players can also add Power Play for an extra $1 to boost non-jackpot prizes by 2X, 3X, 4X, 5X or 10X.
 Prefer to leave it to chance? Choose a Quick Pick and let the computer generate your numbers.
 To win the jackpot, a ticket must match all five white balls and the red Powerball. If no one wins, the jackpot rolls over and continues to grow.
 Do you have to be a U.S. citizen or resident to play Powerball?
 You do not have to be a U.S. citizen or resident to buy a Powerball ticket.
 Anyone who meets the legal age requirement where the ticket is purchased, generally 18 or older, can play while visiting a participating jurisdiction. Winners who live outside the United States are eligible to claim prizes, although taxes may apply.
